mvschwarz/openrig.caption:
Comment “TEAM” and I’ll DM you the link to this repo.

This repo turns Claude and Codex into a seven-agent dev team that you can watch work.

OpenRig boots each agent into a Claude or Codex session, gives it a job and lets them message each other. You can watch your whole team live in a dashboard. O
